हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A fearless bodyguard infiltrates a wealthy but abusive family by marrying into it, only to wage a hidden war against their toxic legacy. With courage, secrets, and unexpected bonds, she sets out to protect the innocent and tear the dynasty apart from within.
